info.title: Thred API
info.description: Search for answers with source details and supporting evidence. Submit a query and retrieve results asynchronously. API keys select workspace and environment.

get.description: Check whether the API service responds. No API key is needed.
Check your key and see its workspace and environment.

get.description: Read operational usage for 1–31 inclusive UTC days. Both dates default to today. searches, attempted_calls, and answered_calls use the search creation date. requested, completed, incomplete, failed, canceled, and elapsed_job_seconds use each call creation date. These counters are not a billing statement.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First UTC date, inclusive. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last UTC date, inclusive. Must be on or after from and no more than 30 days later. Defaults to today.

200.description: Daily operational usage for the selected API environment.

get.description: Read the current status and progress counters for a search. The example shows a completed search. While terminal is false, continue polling. Retrieve the answers from `GET /search/{id}/results`.

Read saved search results in the order they become available. Each result contains an answer, source details, and supporting evidence. Read the next page using next_cursor; continue polling while terminal is false. Reading results does not start more calls. rank preserves each source's relevance rank.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of published results to return on this page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous page of this search. Omit it to start at the first published outcome.

post.description: Stop work that has not started and request cancellation of active calls. Published results remain available. Poll `GET /search/{id}` until terminal is true. Repeated cancellation requests are safe.

202.description: Cancellation requested or terminal search returned.

bearerAuth.description: Send Authorization: Bearer <THRED_API_KEY>. Development keys begin thr_dev_; Production keys begin thr_prod_. Each key is scoped to a workspace and environment. Keep secrets on your server.

Environment.description: The API key selects the workspace environment. Development and Production are isolated, but either can place real calls when enabled.

environment.description: API deployment environment. This is not the environment selected by an API key.

workspace_id.description: Workspace associated with the API key.

key_id.description: Identifier of the authenticated key; never the key secret.

requested.description: Accepted calls, counted on each call creation date. Some may fail before dialing.

completed.description: Calls finalized as completed, attributed to each call creation date.

incomplete.description: Calls finalized as incomplete, attributed to each call creation date.

failed.description: Calls finalized as failed, attributed to each call creation date.

canceled.description: Calls finalized as canceled, attributed to each call creation date.

elapsed_job_seconds.description: Elapsed time recorded when calls close, counted on each call creation date.

searches.description: Accepted searches, attributed to the search creation date.

attempted_calls.description: Calls whose start was attempted, including attempts whose connection outcome is uncertain; counted on the parent search creation date.

answered_calls.description: Calls answered by the destination, including automated answering systems; attributed to the parent search creation date.

attribution.description: searches, attempted_calls, and answered_calls use the search creation date. The other counters use the call creation date.

billed_seconds.description: Always null; these counters are not billing reconciliation.

query.description: The information to obtain. Must contain non-whitespace text. Include location when it matters.
query.example: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

results.description: Hard cap of call attempts to distinct sources. Unanswered calls and negative answers count; successful matches are not guaranteed.

url.description: HTTPS website without embedded credentials, to share when relevant.

call_reason.description: Purpose of the call. Public does not make results publicly accessible.

language.description: Language tag such as en or fr-CA.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to resolve relative dates against this search creation timestamp.

output.description: Optional custom fields to collect, at most 20 fields and 12,000 characters of JSON. If omitted, each result contains a concise natural-language answer in content and no output property; Thred does not generate custom fields. Field names must contain 1–120 characters and cannot be `__proto__`, `prototype`, or `constructor`. Descriptions must contain non-whitespace text.

webhook_id.description: An enabled webhook endpoint in the same workspace/environment.

metadata.description: Custom metadata stored with the search, up to 4000 UTF-8 bytes of JSON. Defaults to an empty object. It is not echoed in status, results, or webhook payloads.

example.query: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

id.description: Search ID returned when the request was accepted.

query.example: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

status.description: Current search state. completed, failed, canceled, and expired are terminal.

url.description: HTTPS website without embedded credentials, to share when relevant.

requested_calls.description: The call-attempt limit supplied in the request results field.

attempted_calls.description: Number of sources where starting a call was attempted.

answered_calls.description: Calls answered by the destination, including automated answering systems.

published_results.description: Number of published result entries available from the results endpoint.

discovery_shortfall.description: Requested calls minus selected sources, bounded at zero. Null until source selection has finished.

deadline_at.description: New dialing stops after 30 minutes. Active calls are canceled; post-call processing may finish later.

finished_at.description: When the search reached a terminal state; null while work is in progress.

terminal.description: Whether all work has settled and no more results will be published.

cancellation_requested.description: Whether cancellation was requested for this search.

stop_reason.description: Reason work was stopped early, when present; null for normal completion.

error.description: Search-level failure details, or null when no search-level error was recorded.

example.query: Where can I buy a Nintendo Switch 2 in Austin today?

rank.description: Relevance rank assigned when the source was selected. Results are returned in the order they become available.

business.description: Source metadata: name, URL, phone number, and address.

status.description: Processing outcome for this source. A completed result can still have null content or output when no supporting transcript evidence was verified.

call_id.description: Identifier of the call associated with this result, or null when no call was created.

content.description: Concise natural-language answer to the query supported by verified transcript evidence. Null when no supported answer is available, including when processing has completed.

output.description: Values for the custom fields explicitly supplied in request.output. Partial results may omit unknown fields. Null when values or supporting transcript evidence are unavailable. This property is omitted when request.output is absent.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the contact transcript.

at_seconds.description: Start time of the matching transcript segment, in seconds from the call timeline.

evidence.description: Supporting excerpts verified against the saved contact transcript.

sources.description: Links used to verify the contact information.

verified_at.description: When the source identity and phone number were verified; this is not the time the answer was obtained.

completed_at.description: Call finalization timestamp, or the outcome publication time when no call finalization timestamp is available.

error.description: Result-level error code as a string, or null when no result-level error was recorded.

outcome.description: Underlying call termination reason when available, or null.

SearchResult.description: A published search result. content is the concise natural-language answer, or null when no supported answer is available. output is included only when the search request explicitly supplies a custom output schema.

example.content: Example Electronics has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

evidence.quote: We have Nintendo Switch 2 consoles in stock. You can pick one up today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

id.description: Search ID associated with this page.

next_cursor.description: Use for the next page or poll this cursor for future results. Returned even on an empty page.

has_more.description: More saved results exist now. False does not imply the search has finished.

terminal.description: No future results will be published for this search.

results.content: Example Electronics has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

evidence.quote: We have Nintendo Switch 2 consoles in stock. You can pick one up today until 6 p.m. Central Time.

results.content: Example Games has the Nintendo Switch 2 in stock for pickup today until 8 p.m. Central Time.

error.description: Request-level error details with a machine-readable code and a message.

BadRequest.description: Invalid JSON, query, options, output fields, cursor, webhook, or date range. Inspect error.code and error.message.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid, revoked, or environment-mismatched bearer API key.

NotFound.description: No matching search in this key’s workspace and environment, or the endpoint does not exist.

TooLarge.description: The request body exceeds 64 KiB. Shorten the query, output descriptions, identity details, or metadata.

RateLimited.description: The workspace/environment already has 20 unfinished searches. Existing searches continue; submit new work after capacity is available.

Unavailable.description: The service or required environment configuration is unavailable. Codes include calling_unavailable, environment_unavailable, not_configured, and backend_unavailable. Inspect error.code and error.message.
